title: HyperFrames registry (456 items)
description: The whole block and component registry of HyperFrames. After a download, hf-import turns every block into a scene and lists the ones that cannot play frame by frame with the reason.
reasons: download the registry folder of heygen-com/hyperframes (1,685 files, 108 MB; HTML + JSON only is about 10 MB), then run: connect-ai-motion hf-import <folder>. Its images, sounds and 3D files have their own terms, so hf-import copies the block HTML only.
